responses.text: Heard you helped out Jackson, thanks for that. Caravans are still waiting for clearance to move out, but at least there's movement.
{Impressed} Coming from the North? Must be crazy to brave those roads.
Outpost, Mojave Outpost. Watching a lot of nothing, feels like a big Brahmin pen for caravans.
They've been stopped for a while, waiting for the roads North to clear - or their clearance papers to go through.
Look like you've walked a ways, so if you need to shake the dust off, head to the Barracks, the bar's there. {Beat, shrugs} Not much, but better than nothing.
Those two? Represents unification. {Beat, a little defeated} Mostly good for shade. Won't do much else when the Legion reaches us.
Nothing I know of, {studies the player} but if you've come from the North, means you can travel freer than most around here.
Might check the Barracks, someone might need you to hoof it somewhere. Just be careful if you go up on the roof - got a sniper watching the road.

If you're gear's in need of repair, HQ's also worth checking out - talk to Major Knight, he can help. {Beat, to himself} Provided you got a pen and plenty of ink. {Slight frustration on bureaucracy at end.}
{Slight shock} What? {Beat} There's no way... we're {emph} miles from the Colorado. They...{To himself} they aren't even waiting for the Dam to fall. They're already inside the borders...
{To himself} ...we'll never stop them, not at this rate. We're doomed. {To player} Thanks for bringing the word - even if the news is bad, I'll let the men know.

topics.prompt: Legion's attacked Nipton, burned and killed everyone.
